title: NVIDIA adds software and hardware boundaries for autonomous agents
friendlyTitle: NVIDIA wants stronger walls around AI agents
summary: NVIDIA’s Open Agent Safety Platform combines the open-source OpenShell runtime with Sentry monitoring and policy enforcement outside the agent’s host process. It is designed to control access to files, networks, tools and credentials, with optional hardware-backed monitoring that can quarantine an agent.
friendlySummary: NVIDIA has introduced tools that limit what an AI agent can see and do. A separate monitoring layer can watch activity and isolate an agent if it breaks the rules.
whyItMatters: Agent safety is moving from prompt instructions into enforceable infrastructure. Organisations deploying agents can use this layered approach as a design pattern: give each agent minimal permissions, log decisions and keep critical enforcement outside the system being supervised.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Written instructions alone are not enough for powerful agents. Businesses should also use technical limits, small permissions and clear activity logs.
